statement: The specified alphabet a,A,b,B reaches all 120 vertices of the recorded norm-one icosian coordinate set by Hamilton multiplication on the right.
assumptions: Use the exact coordinate set and generators in the attached experiment.
Coordinates mean real,i,j,k; field pairs mean rational a+b*sqrt(5).
Keep antipodal elements distinct (SU(2), not the projective quotient).
